alloy.preparation: Smelted in an electric induction furnace under slag; ingots forged and rolled to 2 mm thick bars; held at 1150 °C for 15 min and water quenched.

test_method.procedure_description: Anodic polarization in 0.1 N NaCl to determine passive-film breakdown; Figure 3 specifies 25 °C. Detailed technique is referred to previous literature and is not imported. The separate microscope/orifice pit-distribution apparatus is not assumed to define every registered breakdown-potential measurement.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Reported passive-film breakdown potential; no general numerical current criterion is supplied. For the >1.50 V results, no breakdown occurred up to the stated test limit.

experiments.result_note: Explicit baseline; Table 3 prints 0.644 volts for the quenched condition. The supplied base-steel analysis is Cr 17.93%, Ni 14.38%, C 0.036%; supplementary amounts are separately reported in Table 1/figure coordinates. Full independent base-element analyses for every modified specimen are not supplied; no Fe balance is calculated.

test_method.procedure_description: Anodic polarization in 0.1 N NaCl to determine passive-film breakdown; Figure 3 specifies 25 °C. Detailed technique is referred to previous literature and is not imported. The separate microscope/orifice pit-distribution apparatus is not assumed to define every registered breakdown-potential measurement. Table 3 does not independently state its test temperature, so this field is left null rather than treating the 650 °C anneal as a test temperature.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Reported passive-film breakdown potential; no general numerical current criterion is supplied. For the >1.50 V results, no breakdown occurred up to the stated test limit.

experiments.result_note: Annealed condition is distinct from quenched.  The supplied base-steel analysis is Cr 17.93%, Ni 14.38%, C 0.036%; supplementary amounts are separately reported in Table 1/figure coordinates. Full independent base-element analyses for every modified specimen are not supplied; no Fe balance is calculated. The source calls this a nominal 5% addition; the composition field uses the Table 1 analyzed 4.74 weight percent.
